veranderings.blok: Vier groepe, plus water en vesel
veranderings.rede: 'hulle' for two things reads stiffly; 'albei' is more natural and keeps the word count and meaning.

veranderings.na: en kry nie hulle vitamien C nie
veranderings.rede: 'mis' in the sense of 'miss out on' follows English; 'kry nie ... nie' is the natural Afrikaans for not getting something.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Die algemeenste soort is meer waarskynlik
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In the lesson it continues 'is meer waarskynlik by mense wat ...', which follows English 'is more likely in'; natural Afrikaans would be 'kom meer voor by'. Left unchanged because it is protected; a person may wish to consider it.
